newsitem.title: UK: New UK Tory tax cut plans to cost 1.5 bln stg - IFS.
newsitem.headline: New UK Tory tax cut plans to cost 1.5 bln stg - IFS.

text.p: The Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS) said on Wednesday the new plan by Britain's ruling Conservative Party to offer tax breaks to some married couples if it wins the May 1 election would cost 1.5 billion pounds.
The plans will offer a tax break to married couples where one spouse does not work and stays at home to look after children or elderly relatives.
"The transferrable allowances of married couples with children proposed by the Conservatives would benefit around 2 million families at a cost of 1.5 billion pounds,"
The families affected by the new tax break could gain up to 900 stg per pounds, the IFS said.
